decks.summary: Hit-the-ground-running Ursula for Hard: Milan, Magnifying Glass and Hyperawareness boost her quickly, Shortcut and Unearth the Ancients trigger her free investigation, and evasion keeps her out of fights.
Mythos Busters' solo Ursula who sets up in under three actions with Hawk-Eye Folding Camera, Maleson and Fieldwork, then moves and investigates every turn, passing only the tests that matter.
Combo Ursula who feeds Archaic Glyphs from The Red Clock with Eldritch Sophist and keeps recurring Jeremiah Kirby, for fast clues and a big hand; complex to pilot.
Relic Ursula without Milan: Dr. Elli Horowitz and Backpack fetch The Chthonian Stone, Tooth of Eztli and Decorated Skull, with Archaic Glyphs and Strange Solution to upgrade.
Expert true solo Ursula who rushes the act deck: Magnifying Glass and Fieldwork, Mr. "Rook" to dig, Astounding Revelation and Crack the Case for money, Archaic Glyphs to upgrade.
Combo Ursula who assembles The Pendant of the Queen from three Segments of Onyx and recharges it forever with Eldritch Sophist, for a free testless clue, evade or move every turn.
YouTube Forgotten Age Ursula who races to remote locations with Fingerprint Kit and Deduction, digs with Mr. "Rook", evades with Trench Coat and Hyperawareness, and leaves monsters to others.
Event-heavy co-op Ursula with almost no assets: Connect the Dots, Vantage Point and Crack the Case keep her moving and investigating so the act deck finishes before the Mythos catches up.
Standalone Ursula with Pathfinder, Hemispheric Map and Shortcut for constant free moves, Deciphered Reality and Milan for big clue turns, and Trench Coat to evade; 19 XP.
Solo Forgotten Age Ursula who powers through scenarios before they can kill her, with Hyperawareness for oversuccess, Tooth of Eztli against treacheries, and a few tricks for small enemies.
